_comment: SINGLE SOURCE of the self-heal-relay harness table. bin/self-heal-relay-render stamps it into every language template; never hand-edit a stamped copy (verify with `bin/self-heal-relay-render --verify <file>`). 'verified' = the flags exist in the CLI's own --help AND a live headless round-trip through that exact argv+prompt_via was observed on verified_on. Unverified harnesses are NEVER in the default chain: they run only when the operator names them in MAOS_AI_HARNESS (explicit opt-in).
prompt_prefix: Follow the task described in the prompt you were given. Diagnose the ROOT CAUSE of the fault.

claude.note: use the =-form: --allowedTools is variadic and swallows a following positional prompt

codex.note: --skip-git-repo-check: codex refuses to run outside a trusted git dir otherwise

gemini.note: in an untrusted folder gemini overrides --approval-mode to 'default' (observed 2026-09-23), so the read-only guarantee is not reliable there
propose: Follow the task described on stdin.
apply: Follow the task described on stdin.

opencode.note: no scoped-tool flag found in `opencode run --help`; prompt delivered as a file PATH in argv (never the log content)

crush.note: no scoped-tool flag verified for `crush run`

amp.note: no scoped-tool flag verified for `amp -x`; prompt delivered as a file PATH in argv
